tei:div.tei:p: "$ (373)༄༅// zab lam ni gu chos drug gi bka' bcu'i phyag len bklags chog tu bkod pa bde chen myu gu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(374)༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ lnga ldan nges pa'i bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs// kha sbyor bde chen zag pa med pa'i dbyings// thugs rje'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad rtsom pa// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gus phyag 'tshal// gang las mchog brnyes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma// zab mo'i lam kyi srol 'byed khyung po'i zhabs// khyad par bdag gi dpal mgon drin can rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma mthu stobs bzang por bdud// mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud dbang gi chu 'dzin phreng*// byin rlabs bde chen rab bsil nyams brgya'i gar// ye shes bdud rtsi'i sman char 'dod dgu'i gter// skal bzang yid mkha' mdzes par yongs su 'khrigs// a ho don gnyer slob mas bskul ba dang*// chos 'di'i bka' srol mi nyams 'phel ba'i phyir// brgyud pa'i phyag len 'dzin ma las 'phos pa'i// bde chen myu gu 'phreng ba spel par bya// 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas mkhas grub khyung po'i rnal 'byor la dngos su stsal ba'i zab lam ni gu chos drug dang 'brel ba'i bka' bcu la/ byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi bka' gnyis/ byin rlabs khog phubs kyi bka' gnyis/ byin rlabs gzhung shing gi bka' drug yod pa las dang po bde mchog ni gu lha lnga'i dbang bskur ba nyid yin la/ de ni sgrub dkyil logs su yod pa las rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa bde (375)mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma 'jug pa'i chos so// dang po gnas yid dang mthun pa snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa zhig tu byi dor byas/ stegs mdzes pa'i steng du maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi shar sngo byang ljang nub dmar lho ser ba lte ba sngon po dang lnga la tshom bu lnga bkod/ mdun du mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma lnga'am/ bsdu na gcig tshun bya/ bgegs gtor dang*/ spro na sngon 'gro gtor ma yang bya// tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa g.yon bskor du bsham// rang nyid stan bde ba la 'khod de skyabs 'gro nas nyer bsdu'i bar bdag bskyed sngon du btang*/

mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sum+bha sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te chos thams cad stong pa nyid do// stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'byung bzhi ri rab sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma 'jigs dus kyi gdan la yi ge hūm̐ maṃ tāṃ paṃ laṃ rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus (376)sa bon rnams la thim pa las dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phreng*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer bsdus shing 'jigs su rung ba/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang*/ ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*// gdu bu'i tshogs dang ska rags dang mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa/ thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar dbyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/

phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu snga grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyud pa yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo// thams cad kyang (377)zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mtshan khung du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas shing*/ mi'i ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs shing phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ phaiṃ/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par ā dmar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo dang mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang*/ lā ma la don grub/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/

mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam ba ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang*/ nang mchod/ sum+bha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ de'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur/ yi ge bdun pa bzla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thod pa'i steng gi he ru ka lha lnga'i sku la thim/ sbyor mtshams dang gsang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ gzhir gnas kyi dam rdzas (378)dang 'dres te ye shes kyi bdud rtsis thod pa gang bar gyur pa la/ lha lnga po rnams kyang bdud rtsir zhu ste thim/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sogs lha lnga so so'i snying po la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ spro na/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa bya/ rigs kun bdag po bcom ldan he ru ka /gnyis med sbyor mdzad rdo rje btsun mo che// mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma// dpal chen lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// skabs 'dir gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la 'bul zhing*// 'og tu 'byung ba ltar maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag 'jug gi tshul du slob ma la bya ba phal cher ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul du dbang blang*/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug pa'i rim pa la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis bgegs la gtor ma sbyin la tsham rngam bya/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du gsang sngags zab mo'i chos gsan snyam pa'i kun slong dang*/ kun spyod spyi bye brag rnams gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/

gang gsan par bya ba ni 'dir zab lam ni gu chos drug gi bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ slob mas dbyangs dang bcas te/ bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog / ces sogs maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma byed pa gzhan kun la 'gre'o// de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag (379)la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag kyang 'jug par 'tshal// lan gsum bya/ de nas thun mong gi rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su// nam zhig byang chub snying po la// yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu// bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems// ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom (380)pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces lan gsum bya/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le byas la/ khyed rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying kha raṃ hūm̐/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re gsal btab nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ slob dpon gyis snying khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag nas byin rlabs brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas dam la bzhag pa'i slad du rdo rje mgo bor gtad nas tshig 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing*// mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur// snying khar rdo rje gtugs te ye shes dbab pa gsang bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral du gshegs// bdud rtsi lnga yi chu blud nas dam tshig bsrung bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig bsrung bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab bo// deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' (381)stsal pa// gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis/

gal te nga la brnyas na ni// sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re// zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi// byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bde mchog lha lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs brgyud bskul// de las de dang 'dra ba'i bde mchog lha lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi cha thams cad la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya/ yab yum gyi snying po nye snying mthar/ ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa gang mang brjod do// sngon 'gro lnga pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bzhi lus bsgribs kyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du ma yengs par thugs 'dun drag pos spyan dmigs 'di rnams bsgom mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma ram las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la yi ge hūm̐ mthing ga zhig gsal 'debs pa zhu/ de bzhin du mgrin par paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dkyil du āḥdamar po 'bur skyes zhig gsal 'debs pa zhu/ yang snying khar (382)pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la hūm̐ mthing ga zhig gsal 'debs pa zhu/ de nas lte bar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa gcig gi gnang du baṃ dmar po zhig gsal 'debs pa zhu/

de nas spyi bo'i hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas khams gsum gyi sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan sngar yod kyi steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal he ru ka yab yum rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa la ḍā ki ma bzhis g.yon bskor du kho ro ro bskor ba byed pa la dmigs pa drag tu gtod mdzod/ de ltar bsgoms pas drod skyes/ dga' ba nyams su myong ste bum dbang gi ngo sprod yin no// de nas bum dbang gi dbang bzhi'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod// de yang spyi bor ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa yi dam gyi sku'i ngo bo lha lnga gsal ba de la khyed rang rnams kyis lus longs spyod dang dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas phul bas thugs rgyud bde bas gang nas mnyes par bsams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su bskur du gsol/ de nas bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i he ru ka'i thugs ka'i sa bon yi ge hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ 'od dkar po byung bas rang gi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ de nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ de nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab// yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob// de nas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor (383)lo 'od kyis khyab pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzad nas dar gcig mnyam par zhog mdzod/
yi ge bdun pa bzla zhing ḍā dril dkrol lo// de ni bum dbang gi dbang bzhi yin no//

zhes brda sprad/ de nas spyi bo'i lha mo bzhi yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab 'od du zhu nas spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs te/ mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po 'bur skyes de la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma yi dam gyi gsung gi ngo bo āḥdamar po de la dar cig sems gtod mdzod/ de ltar gtad pas sems la bde ba skyes/ mchog tu dga' ba nyams su myong*/ de gsang dbang gi ngo sprod yin no// de nas gsang dbang dngos kyi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mgrin pa'i nang gi bla ma yi dam rnams kyi gsung gi ngo bo āḥdamar po de la sngar ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dang dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas phul bas/ thugs rgyud bde bas gang nas mnyes par bsam la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bla ma rin po ches bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i nang gi āḥdamar po de las 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bde phri li li byung nas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad 'od kyis khyab pas/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzad nas dar cig mnyam par zhog mdzod spos rol dang yi ge bdun pa bzla zhing ḍā dril bya ba 'gre/ de ni gsang ba'i dbang gi ngo bo yin no// de nas mgrin pa'i pad 'dab 'od du zhu ba āḥdamar po la thim/ āḥ'od du zhu nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi hūm̐ mthing kha de la thim/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur (384)pa las bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de yang rtsa ba'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhis gtso bo la bskor ba byed pa la dar cig sems gtod mdzod/ de ltar bsgoms pas lus sems la mi rtog pa skyes/

dga' bral gyi dga' ba nyams su myong ste shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo sprod yin no// de nas dbang gsum pa bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi bla ma yi dam gyi thugs kyi ngo bo bde mchog lha lnga'i de la sngar ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dang dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas phul bas thugs rgyud bde bas gang nas mnyes par bsams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od sngon po byung nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad 'od kyis khyab pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzad nas dar gcig mnyam par zhog mdzod// sngags rol bya / de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no// de nas snying kha'i lha mo bzhi yum la thim yum yang yab la thim/ yab 'od du zhu ba'i lte ba'i chos 'byung nang gi bam dmar po la thim/ bam yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas na cang te'u'i sgra dang bcas pa/ g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa/ sku mdog dmar mo// rus pa'i rgyan can khro la 'dzum pa sgeg pa gar byed pa/ de la dar cig sems gtod mdzod/ de ltar bsgoms pas lus sems la drod bde ba mi rtog pa gsum skyes/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ste dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod yin no// de nas dbang bzhi pa bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di (385)bzhin mdzod/ lte ba'i chos 'byung nang gi bla ma yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la sngar ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas phul bas thug rgyud bde bas gang ste mnyes par bsam la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rnal 'byor ma'i shangs bug g.yas nas a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṛ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ/ zhes ā li'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon pa nas ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa zhes kā li'i phreng ba byung nas rnal 'byor ma'i smin mtshams su yi ge de rnams g.yung drung ris dmar po gcig tu gyur nas de drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtod mdzod/ mthar rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ khyed rang gi phung po yang 'od phung lta bu la stong sangs kyis song nas/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya/ de nas slar chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i tshul du stong pa de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku sgyu ma lta bu snang la zhen pa med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu lam gyis bzhengs par bsgom mdzod/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la slob dpon gyis yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga yang phul ba'i mos pa mdzod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya rnams brjod/ dbang gi phan yon ni sngar dbang thob pa'i nyams pa rnams gso ba dang*/ sdig pa thams cad yongs su zad pa dang*/ lhan (386)cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar 'gyur pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la sogs khyad par can thob pa'i dgos pa yod do// des bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi lus bsgrig ge ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur grub/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs thams cad tshul bzhin du bsrung ngo snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs bya/ rjes kyi cho ga yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bzod gsol bya/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying khar bsdu'o// zab gnad mang po thos pa'i blos// ting 'dzin dbang chog rab gsal 'di// shangs chos bstan pa 'dzin 'dod pa can// nyams khrid skyong la mkho phyir bris// zab lam ni gu chos drug dang 'brel ba'i slob ma rjes su 'dzin thabs/ bde chen myu gu'i phreng ba zhe bya ba klo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi bka' gnyis kyi rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o/// / ༈ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// dngos po kun gyis gus btud nas// byin rlabs khog phub bka' gnyis las// dang pa bdag gis bshad par bya// 'dir zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khog phub kyi bka' dang po sgyu lus dbang mo che bskur ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba zhig 'bri ba las/ dang po rgyas pa ni/ sa sbyang bzung sngon du 'gro bas gzhal yas khang spyi dang 'dra ba la rta babs bzhi yod pa gcig gi thig btab/ de'i nang du tshangs thig gis bcad pa'i lte ba'i dang zur bzhir zlum bskor bzhi'i rab bskor te shar lho'i zlum skor la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig btab/ nub byang dang*/ byang shar gnyis kyi zlum skor la chos 'byung rkyang pa re dang*/ lho nub tu pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i bcad bya'o// gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du ra ba gsum bskor te thig gi rim pa'o// de la tshon bkye ba ni gzhan spyi 'gre bzhin las/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus su nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gcig 'bri/ shar lho'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dkar po la bcad mthing nag /me ri dmar po// dbus su nyi gdan lnga tshom la/

tshom bu mthing kha lnga bkod/ lho nub kyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog gi lte bar nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po bkod// (386)byang shar gyi chos 'byung dmar po bcad ljang khu/ gru bcad dkar po yod pa'i dbus su nyi gdan lnga tshom la dbus dkar/ shar nag /lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu'i tshom bu lnga bkod/ nub byang gi grwa'i chos 'byung nag po// me ri dmar po/ gru bcad ljang gu/ zlum skor gyi char mu khyud nag po yod pa'i dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po bkod do// gzhal yas khang gi phyir gsum la mu khyud phyi nas rim pas dkar po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngon po gsum gyi khor yug bya ste dang po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten dang*/ gnyis pa de'i nang du me ri dang*/ gsum pa de'i nang du rdo rje'i ra ba rnams yod pa mtshon pa yin la sku gsung thugs gsum mtshon pa'ang yin gsung ngo*// gnyis pa 'bring pa bya na ni/ 'dod snam dmar*/ pha gu ser/ dra phyed nag shar bu sngo/ mda' yab rnams dor te dkar*/ rtsigs pa ljang khu dang*/ sgo khyud/ sgo 'gram/ sgo log /sgo steng gi gdugs dang bcas pa zhig bya ste gzhan snga ma ltar ro// gsum pa bsdus pa ni// rtsigs pa phan chad kyi gzhal yas khang mi 'bri par maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa phyogs mdog can la zlum skor bzhi po'i chos 'byung dang pad+ma gong bzhin bris la phyi'i mu khyud gru bzhi re khā dkar po bya'o// dkyil 'khor bya thabs bshad zin to// da ni bsham bkod tshul la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi stegs bur mdun du zlum skor māṃ sas brgyan pa gnyis/ go skabs ci bde bar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnams dang 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzas dang tshogs kyi yo byad sogs bzhag go /bum pa ni lho nub kyi grwa'i pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor der 'jog pa dbang chog las gsungs pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor rgya khyon chen po yod na der mañdzi'i steng du bzhugs rgyu yin mod kyi/

phyag len la ni dkyil 'khor che na zlum skor bzhi tshom gyi dbus su mañdzi la 'jog gin 'dug /de min dkyil 'khor chung ngu la bum pa logs su bshams pa legs so// bum pa ni mgul ching kha rgyan dang bcas pa sogs bsham tshul spyi dang 'dra yang dung chos gzungs thag ni mi dgos so// 'di nyid kyi dbang chog las/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la tshom bu lnga pa 'god pa lnga pa gsungs shing*/ der lha mi bskyed kyang bum chu'i gdan yin pas bum nang gi lha rnams mtshon pa 'dra ba dang*/ chos 'byung dmar po'i steng du bde mchog lha lnga bskyed pa ltar gsungs shing*/ (388)deng sang yang phal cher yi ge nag 'gros ltar byed la lhan thabs kyi yi ge 'ga' re na'ang de dang 'dra min tsam bshad kyang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas de rnams man ngag gab pa yin cing*/ khyad par lhan thabs kyi yi ge na/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su 'das pa'i bla ma/ zhes sogs 'chad pa ni shin tu ma dag gsung*/ des na rang lugs zhal shes kyi phyag len ni chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dang bum pa'i nang du rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bsdus pad+ma 'dab bzhi la bla ma rdo rje 'chang la mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba'am/ bla ma'i ngo bo bde mchog lha lnga/ chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du rdo rje phag mo lha lnga bsgom pa yin no// sbyor ba'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyi cho ga dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ sum+bha sa bsang*/ swa bha wa sa sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin rlabs bya/ phaiṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+wam/ dri sh+ya ho ces pas mthon bkug / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sabhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ u da man+ta/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba ling tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me prats+tshan+tu/

ya thai bam/ ya theṃṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya/ sad su kham/ bi shud+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsum/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ srin po'i= 'byung po'i= sha za'i= smyo byed= rjed byed= ma mo'i= de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'bora'akhor bcas la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dam can khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// las la srung ba dam pa dang*// yul phyogs 'di dang sbyin bdag dang*// slob ma la yang shis par mdzod// gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa// gtor (389)ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na// rdo rje 'dzin chen khros pa'i bkas// mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sprin spros nas// lus sems rdul du brlag ta re/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor la sum+bha ni drag rol bya/ de nas mchod pa dang gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ sum+bha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i/ bh+rūṃ las gnas khang gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams las byung zhing*/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ yul dus chad pa med par yongs su khyab cing*// rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las rang gzhan mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas phyi nang thams cad du gang bar gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ sur sur/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇa ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pa rā mi ta/ nā da sam+bha bi te/ badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā lan gsum brjod/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun pa bya/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ (390)hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud ma lus pa sbyangs nas/ slar 'dus te 'od du zhu ba thig ler gyur/ de las rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ 'og phyogs su chad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūm̐ spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dang*/ de las 'phros pa'i rwa gur du gyur cing*/ hūm̐ las hūm̐ dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu ba'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med par gtams/ nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu zhu ste rwa gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing*/ phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ

nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// lan gsum bya/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste/ me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang tshogs zhing dbyer med du gyur/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun pa bsgom/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba ཿswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do// oṃ shūn+ya ta nas/ ko3 haṃ/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te chos thams cad stong pa nyid do// stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan/ de'i steng du rang sems hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ he ru ka yab yum gyi go 'phang la (391)bkod/ de rnams thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ hūm̐ yig rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+rā nī la ltar rab tu 'bar pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar bde mchog lha lnga'i skabs bzhin no// yab kyi sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa yon tan gyi ngo bo rang dang mtshungs pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum/ bde chen 'khor lor sku gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po yid tsam khro ba/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang mtshungs kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// longs spyod 'khor lor gsung ma hā mā yā mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang mtshungs la 'khyud pa/

skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la mi ro mnan pa'o// chos kyi 'khor lor thugs dges mdzad rdo rje mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi pad nyi la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa'o// bde skyong 'khor lor phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i zhal can/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas/ yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skra ser gyen du brjes shing*/ dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa/ g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la ma he mnan pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/(392)rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs gnas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gsang mchod dang de kho na nyid kyis mchod pas mchod de mnyes par gyur/ bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rab rdzogs pa// dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo//

ces bstod/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa 'di gtso bor bzla zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛ ka hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wiṣ+ṭi tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams ci rigs pa bzla'o// mthar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid he ru ka yab rkyang du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'o// de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ (394)swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su phyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten nang srung 'khor rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pas bskor ba/ de'i nang du gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod snam dang pha gu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khur gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor dang po'i nang gi chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus dang*/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga tshom du gnas pa la dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga / zhes pa nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog nas brgyan pa'o// lhor dges mdzad rdo rje mthing kha/ nas/ drag po mnan pa'o// nub tu ma hā mā yā ma thing ga nas/ mi ro mnan pa'o// byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag nas/ yang dbang chog gi dpe mang por/ shar du dgyes mdzad/ lhor gsang 'dus bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung ste gdam ga'o//

ma he mnan pa'o// dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i lte ba la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po yid tsam khro ba/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo// byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams gri gug dang*/ thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ dkyil (394)'khor gsum pa chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo// nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu rnams ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa rang mtshungs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o// dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag drug pa sku mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas rnams na thod skam gyi phreng ba dang*/ gri gug dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon rnams na thod khrag dang*/ rtsa gsum dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ dgra bgegs dang yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ spos dang rol mo'i sgra chen po dang bcas te/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes lan gsum/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka= oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa= oṃ de wa pi tsu=

oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi= oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai badz+ra warna nī yai badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la khīṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nā bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa= badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ k+ṣiṃ mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mang du brjod do// gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta (395)bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+rā+e bha wa a bha ṣeñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bo rnams dang bla ma dang*/ nag po chen po la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ mkha' 'gro lnga po rnams la rigs lnga so so'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod phreng rgyas pa bde mchog lha lnga ltar bya zhing*/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pa d+yaṃ dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ ra ṇi sogs rol chen bya/ nang mchod/ sum+bha sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ de'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur/ yi ge bdun pa bzla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thod pa'i steng gi he ru ka lha lnga'i sku la thim/ sbyor mtshams dang gsang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ gzhir gnas kyi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te ye shes kyi bdud rtsis thod pa gang bar gyur pa la/

lha lnga po rnams kyang bdud rtsir zhu ste thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ sogs bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor nang ltar rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal gyi ni gu ma/ khyung po dzo ki rat+na bid+ya sogs// rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zab gsang rgyud sde lnga yi bcud bsdus pa// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i smin grol lam// dngos su 'doms mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam= 'khor lo bde mchog gsang 'dus dges mdzad dang*// sgyu ma chen mo rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la// rnam= myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs mgon re ma tī// k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*// ṭā ki rā dza bdud (396)mgon traka shad la// rnam= phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu yi dbang po dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dur khrod gnas pa'i tshogs// gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag ma lus la// rnam= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus tha med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// ces phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa phul// bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag nas/ phag mo la 'dud do// thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// dgyes mdzad rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i// zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa// dud kha mun chen khyed la 'dud// chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku// bstan pa'i ru dra 'joms mdzad pa'i// nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod//

gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la rgyud sde lnga'i snying po dang oṃ gsum ma dang*/ mgon po'i snying po rnams kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum/ mgon po la khyad par du/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la shā sa na/ u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣo3 pañtsi ma kā lo a yi i daṃ/ rat+na tra yā ya a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra ti dz+nyā/ smar si tā da/ i daṃ du ṣ+ṭaṃ khā kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra// ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ (397)sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rab rdzogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gdub dang bcas bi na ya ka mnan// nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can// phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yas pas gri gug bar pas phreng ba 'dzin// tha mas ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum// de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed// drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar// dpral bar sin+dhu ra yi thig les byugs// spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal po'i rgyas btab brtan// khrag 'dzag mi mgo lngaṃ bcu'i do shal can/ rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gis phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams dmigs pas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang*/

tshogs kyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlab bo// slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa bstan zin to// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ khrus phyag sngon du btang nas bral du 'khod pa la las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu bya// slob dpon gyis bgegs la gtor ma byin la bgegs bskrad la srung 'khor gsal btab/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che sku tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos gsan snyam pa'i kun slong kun spyod spyi bye brag rnams gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni zab lam ni gu chos drug gi byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis yod pa las da lam sgyu lus dbang mo che 'bul ba skabs su (398)babs pa yin/ de la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis yod pa'i dang po la/ bsam pa 'chos pa/ 1 skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba/ 2 spro ba bskyed pa/ 3 gsol ba 'debs pa/ 4 gnang ba sbyin pa/ 5 nyan par gdams pa/ 6 yan lag lnga pa bya ba/ 7 sdom pa bzung ba/ 8 gsang ba bsgrags pa/ 9 ye shes dbab pa dang bcu yod pa las/ dang po bsam pa 'chos pa ni/ da res rang cag rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang sgos su gsang sngags kyi theg pa zab mo dang mjal/ skabs 'dir chos la 'bad na bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang sgrub dka' ba min na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang da res chos la ma 'bad na phyis mi lus thob pa tsam yang rnyed dka'/ mi lus ma thob na chos byed pa'i skal pa gtan nas med/ chos ma byas na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol ba mi srid/ mi lus lan gcig thob pas phan pa yang ma yin gyi/ nges par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med/

'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan/ shi nas khungs med du song na de ka yin mod kyi/ de lta bu ma yin te da lta'i dgra gnyen longs spyod sogs tshe 'di'i snang ba kun dang bral yang*/ sems khungs med du mi 'gro/ mi 'dod kyang las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gang rung du skye ba las 'os med/ gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na yin/ sdug bsngal de yang zad mi shes shing thar bar dka' ba'i rgya mtsho dang mtshungs par 'dug pa la/ de las nges par thang dgos pa 'dug /de yang rang gcig pu thar pas mi phan gyi sems can thams cad thar bzhag byed dgos pa 'dug /de'i ched du dbang gsan snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung pa zhig bskyed mdzod/ gnyis pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi slad du mdun gyi nam (399)mkhar skyabs yul rnams khra lam me bzhugs par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag

ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la= tshogs rnams kyi mchog /byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= zhes lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa sems bskyed la gnyis kyi dang po smon pa sems bskyed kyi slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na nas/ dgongs su gsol// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pas tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung nas/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi slad du 'di'i rjes= phyogs bcu nas dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di (399)bzhes bgyi pas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mthar gyis bslab pa dang*/ mthar gyis sbyang ba dang*/ mthar gyis bsgrub par bgyi'o// de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/

bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin= brtson 'grus kyi pha rol= bsam gtan gyi pha rol= shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa rnams la mthar gyis bslab pa dang*/ mthar gyis sbyangs pa dang*/ mthar gyis bsgrub par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ gsum pa spro ba skyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'// sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// dkyil 'khor dam par gzhug bya ste// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// bdag don tshe 'di gnyer byed na// gzhan don sangs rgyas ga la 'byung*// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// zhes brjod do// bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos= dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// ces lan gsum/ lnga pa gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ bu tshur theg pa chen po pa// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs (401)pa rnams/ de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// tshig bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// ye shes mnyam med thob pas na// skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru kas// bdud ni shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de kas bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ ces brjod la don bshad do// drug pa rtog pa bsdu ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po'i sems kyis nyon// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs dang*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// ces brjod la don bshad do// bdun pa yan lag lnga pa bya ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes bzlos= bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid stsal rjes su yi rang gang*/ sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag bdag gis bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// bsgoms dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyis// tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// zhes lan gsum bya/ brgyad pa sdom pa 'dzin pa'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces pa'i bar lha lnga'i skabs bzhin lan gsum brjod du gzhug / dgu pa gzengs bstod cing gsang ba bsgrag pa sogs las dang po gzengs bstod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab bo// 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen (402)rnams// u dum+bā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byed// gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru// sdig pa'i las rnams byas pa yang*// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong bas// de dag thams cad byang 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// gang gis bskal pa dpag med du// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags kyang*// 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'// des kyang 'di la dga' bar gyis//

zhes brjod la don bshad do// de nas sngar dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod// oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gis thig le byas te/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gsal btab nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ slob dpon gyis snying gar rdo rje bzhag la brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod// oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas gsang ba bsgrag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ bcu pa nang du gzhug cing ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob dpon gyi shar sgo nas rdo rjes khrid par bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su dbu dud par mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nang du 'khod pa la ye shes dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag byed pa 'dir gda'/ ye shes (403)ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na// dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos// de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'o// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re// zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzung nas dang*/

yang snying gar rdo rje gtugs te/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// yang spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te chu la 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro// ces pas nyes dmigs dang*/ las bum gyi bum chu dang bdud rtsi bsres la khyor ba g.yas par byin la 'thung ngu bcug cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis bsgrub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha/ zhes pas phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis dang*// yang spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig byas pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan 'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go /bcu pa ye shes dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// rdo rje ye shes bla med ni// da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ khyed rang rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i rkang mthil gzhibs nas langs par mos pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can/ gzhu rgyud gyen la bstan pa'i (404)steng du gnas pa'i rkang pa'i mthil gnyis su dzā+eṃ me'i rang bzhin rlung gis bskyod pas me 'bar ba/ rtsa nang nas yar song*/ sum mdo'i me dang lte bar ram las me'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dres/ snying gar lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rjes mtshan pa bsregs pas/

mgrin par bam las chu'i dkyil 'khor bam gyis mtshan pa khol/ spyi bor yam las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bus thur du mnan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang he ru ka mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams las/ de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi lha tshogs sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya/ rgyud sde lnga dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mgon po'i snying po dang na mo bud+dha ya'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags la ye shes phab/ de nas me tog dor ba ni/ lha thams cad dag pa ye shes gcig gi snang ba yin pas bzang ngan med mod kyi rang gi las 'brel yod pa'i lha la 'bab par shog gcig snyam pas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ gsung zhing me tog dor mdzod/ slob dpon gyis gang la babs pa'i lha'i snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog gi phreng bas slar khyed rang la dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod// (405)oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+wam/ i mam sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes spyi bor gtad/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzod// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa lam hri/ zhes gdong g.yogs bsal/

de'ang phyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten rin po che gser las grub pa'i rnam pa la/ nang gzhal yas khang gi dbus na rgyud sde lnga la sogs pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa rnams ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i ngo bo yin te/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ de nas yang dag bshad par bya// sku ni kyai rdo rje la// gsung ni sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'o// thugs ni 'khor lo bde mchog che// phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid// bdag nyid gsang ba 'dus par brjod// ma 'ongs sems can don du ni// thabs 'di dag ni bstan pa yin// thabs kyi rim pa 'di dag ni// kun gyi thun mong ma yin te// dkyil 'khor gcig bsdus dbang bskur bas// gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rgyud sde rnam lngar gang bstan pa// kla klo'i skad kyis 'dir sbas pas// thub pa'i zhal thems gsang ba 'di// snying po kun gyi don gyi rgyud// dka' thub spyod byed thun mong min// zhes sogs gsungs te de lta bu'i bdag nyid can rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ de dag ni rgyas pa la spro ba'i don du 'jug sgo yon tan kun 'byung bzhin bkod pa yin la/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i bzhed pa ltar na mig dar 'ching ba dang me tog dor ba sogs mi mdzad par gsal/ dam bzhag gi tshig phal cher yang lha lnga'i skabs bzhin mdzad pa yod do// gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi gsum ste/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba/ mthar thugs (405)gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o// dang po bum dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs lan gsum/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ gsung ma hā mā ya/

thugs kyai rdo rje/ yon tan 'khor lo bde mchog /phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis shis pa brjod/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i phyag tu bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo'i 'khor lor slebs/ des bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag /'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa gsang dbang gi don du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa yab yum thams cad bde ba'i ngo bor zhu// mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gtso bo rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i cha thams cad brgyud// rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi gsang ba'i mtsho skyes su byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

nang mchod la bum chu nas cung zad spros te byin/ hūm̐/ phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ sarba (406)ta thā ga ta gu h+ye a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ bum chu dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mgrin par slebs/ des gsang ba'i dbang bskur pa thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag /'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi don du bum chu spyi bor gtor bas khyed rang rnams lha sku yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par gnas pa la thugs rgyud bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nas sbyin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dz+nya dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ bum chu'i rgyun dang bdud rtsis snying gar slebs/ des dbang gsum pa'i ye shes skyes/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag /'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che'i don du bum chu gtor bas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ phyogs dus nas sbyin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsa tu r+tha a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ bum chu dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun lte bar slabs/ lus thams cad gang*/ des dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'i mos pa dang bcas te cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod// des btags pa brda'i dbang bzhi'am/ bum pa'i dbang bskur song ba yin/ gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ngam/ thob pa don gyi dbang bzhi zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / de nas 'di la dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba dang*// gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba gnyis yod pa las/

dang po bskur bar bya ba'i don du khyed rang rnams kyi lus (408)dang longs spyod phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong la 'bul bar mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis/ bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis/ bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang zhu ba dang*/ nyams su len pa la bar chad thams cad bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum bya/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad oṃ dkar po'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ de nyid 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le dkar po gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas rang lus kyang 'od dkar po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu/ nyon mongs pa gti mug sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par āḥdamar po de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad āḥdamar po'i rnam par bsdus/ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ āḥde nyid 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu ste/ mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le dmar po gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas rang lus kyang 'od dmar po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar hūm̐ (409)sngon po de las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de nyid 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu ste/ snying kha nas zhugs te lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le sngon po gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas rang lus kyang 'od sngon po'i rnam par ldem ldem zhu/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar trāṃ ser po de las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan gyi byin rlabs thams cad trāṃ ser po'i rnam par bsdus// lte ba'i trām̐ la thim/ trām̐ de nyid 'od zer ser po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu ste snying kha nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le ser po gcig tu song*// de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas rang lus kyang 'od zer ser po'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor āḥljang gu de las 'od zer ljang khu 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad āḥljang khu'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i āḥl thim/ āḥde nyid 'od zer ljang khu'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu ste spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le ljang khu gcig tu song*/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas rang lus kyang 'od ljang khu'i rnam par ltem ltem zhu/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid dwangs ma ye shes lnga ldan bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal sing nger gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel (410)ba'i rim pa grub/ gnyis pa gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba la/

dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud cing*/ 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bskor ba la// mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad blos ling gis phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas bla ma'i sku'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po skya nar gyis byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin phrag tu thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /rang lus lha sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces byas la sems cung zad 'dzin pa phyi ma gnyis la'ang 'gre/ yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lce la thim pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag /rang lus lha sku snga ma las kyang gsal bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum nas/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas sems kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /lha sku gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar dbang gsum po re re'i mthar lha sku la cung zad sems 'dzin du 'jug par gsung pa lags/ de nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ (411)dus gsum nas/ bdag la bzhi ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/

khyed rang rnams kyi lus sems khong slod la/ gshis cir yang ma grub cing*/ gdangs gang yang 'gags pa med pa thol skyes rang byung gi shes pa so ma 'di la bzo bcos med par lhan ner mnyam par zhog cig /de ni sems spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bya ba/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes lags so// des thob pa don gyis dbang bzhi song*/ gsum pa mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi bskur ba 'di la yang sngon 'gro gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba dang dngos gzhi dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba gnyis yod pa'i dang po la gsum ste/ stong ras gzhi bca' ba dang*/ rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ dag pa'i lha skur bsgom pa'o// dang po ni khyed rang rnams lha skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar ba yar rtse tshangs bug dang mar rtse gsang gnas su zug pa zhig gsal btab pa'i dbu ma de'i nang gi snying kha'i thad du a dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig yod par bsam nas ngag tu a a zhes lan mang du brjod cig /a a/ zhes brjod du gzhug / de nas a de las 'od zer 'phros/ thog mar dbu ma dang*// de nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus gang*/ mthar rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad a yig gi 'od kyis khyab pas thams cad 'od du ldem ldem 'dug pa la cung zad sems gtad pas de rnams kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ gnyis pa rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ yang khyed rang rnams lha skur gsal ba la/ rtsa dbu ma yang sngon bzhin du gsal btab nas/ dbu ma'i spyi bo'i thad du haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba dang*/ mgrin pa'i (412)thad du āḥdamar po mgo bo gyen du lta ba dang*/ snying kha'i thad du hūm̐ mthing nag mgo bo thur du lta ba dang*/ lte ba'i thad du am dmar ser mgo bo gyen du lta ba rnams sgoms mdzod/

de ltar dbu ma'i nang du yi ge bzhi gsal btab nas thog mar spyi bo'i ham las 'od zer gsal sing nge 'byung*/ mgrin pa'i āḥl phog /de las 'od zer gsal sing nge byung*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la phog /de las 'od zer gsal sing nge byung*/ lte ba'i am la phog /lus sems thams cad bde cham cham song bar sgom mdzod/ yang 'od zer yar log te/ lte ba'i am las 'od zer gsal sing gis byung*/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la phog /de las 'od zer gsal sing gi byung*/ mgrin pa'i āḥl phog /de las 'od zer gsal sing gis byung*/ spyi bo'i ham la phog /lus sems thams cad bde cham cham song*/ de ltar yas rim dang mas rim du 'phros pa'i 'od zer de rnams kyis rtsa gnas thams cad gang*/ 'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa mdud thams cad grol/ rtsa nang 'od zer gyis gang ba'i rkyen gyis rtsa rnams kyang 'ja' 'od du ldem ldem 'dug par bsam la cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ gsum pa dag pa'i lha sku sgom pa ni/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi lus bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal ba'i rdo rje nor bu'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po mgo bo gyen du bstan pa'i hūm̐ gi rtse mo la thig le dmar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/ spyi bor ham dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ ham gi rtse mo la'ang thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/ de nas 'og rlung cung zad 'then pa'i rkyen gyis hūm̐ de yar yong bas gsang ba'i dbang po phyi nang ldog pa bzhin du hūm̐ gis khrid nas yar byung ste/ hūm̐ snying khar slebs/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /yang steng rlung cung zad mnan pa'i rkyen gyis spyi bo'i ham snying khar slebs/ nyon (413)mongs pa gti mug dag /gnyis po snying khar 'dzom pas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rang dag la song bar sgoms shig /mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang gi skabs 'dir/ de yan chad ni sngon 'gro gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba zhes bya ba yin la/

da ni dngos gzhi dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i ham yig de thig le dkar po la thim/ snying kha'i hūm̐ yig de thig le dmar po la thim/ thig le dkar dmar de gnyis snying khar 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba la sems gtod la/ 'di thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam du 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de bum dbang yin/ thig le gnyis po de snying gar 'khor bas gcig rjes gcig gis zin pa'i tshul gyis reg reg 'dug pa la sems gtod la sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyongs shing*// de gsang dbang yin/ de ltar thig le gnyis reg pas lus sems bde bas khyab pa la sems gtod la sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de sher dbang yin/ thig le gnyis po gcig la gcig thim nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang der/ gang yang bsgom rgyu med/ bsam rgyu med pa'i tshul/ rig pa gtad med kyi ngang du rang gar zhog cig /de dbang bzhi pa yin/ spros bral de kha'i ngang las bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i zung 'jug tu gsal legs par thob la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de dag gis sgyu lus dbang mo che'i rim pa phul grub pa yin/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ngo snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum bya/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran tu/ sogs kyis yon 'bul ba rnams bya/ tshogs phud 'bul ba nas tshogs lhag gi bar tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba rnams kyang skabs (413) 'dir byed/ rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlab/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyi mchod/ snying po so so'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis gshegs su gsol// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / sogs kyi smon lam btab/ legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa/ zhes sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ sogs kyi bsngo ba bya'o// blo dman 'ga' la mkho phyir du// gsal byed yi ge spel ba'i dges// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i rgyun// skyong ba'i bden tshig 'grub par smon// sku lus dbang mo che'i bka' bya tshul brjod zin to/ ༈ rgyud sde lnga yi lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyis nas// byin rlabs khog phub bka' gnyis kyi// phyi ma bdag gis bshad par bya/ 'dir rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ de la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po la maṇ+ḍal bskyed chog ltar ram/ bsdu na pad+ma 'dab brgyad la lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu lnga bkod la/ mchod gtor lha lnga'i skabs dang phal cher 'dra ba dang*/ bgegs gtor bsham/ bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi'i khar bkod bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rgyud sde lnga'i bdag bskyed bsgom pa dang*/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa dang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang gsum gyi dang po sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/

rang nyid he ru ka yab rkyang du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'o// zhes pa'i bar sngar bstan pa nyid nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbus su// seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'jigs (415)byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga nas bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing kha nas phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o// zhes pa'i bar bde mchog lha lnga bzhin// shar du dges mdzad rdo rje mthing kha nas drag po mnan pa'o// lhor gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po nas rin po ches brgyan pa'o// nub tu ma hā ma ya mthing kha nas mi ro mnan pa'o// byang du 'jigs mdzad rdo rje mthing nag ma he'i zhal can nas ma he mnan pa'o// rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar rgyud sde lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod// ces pa'i bar mchod bstod rnams sgyu lus dbang mo che'i skabs bzhin bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ bzlas pa rnams kyang phal cher de bzhin bya ste/ 'on kyang mgon po sogs kyi gsang sngags bzhag /gsum pa slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod nas/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos gsan snyam du thugs bskyed dang kun spyod gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir zab lam ne gu chos drug gi byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis kyi nang nas shin tu zab pa rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi dbang bskur ba zab mo 'bul ba skabs su babs pa yin/

de la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis yod pa'i dang po sngon 'gro'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ nas/ 'jug par 'tshal/ gsum/ de nas thun mong gi rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum/ de nas (416)rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ nas/ 'das la 'god/ gsum/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le bya zhing*/ khyed rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re// zhes pa'i dam bzhag par bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhin bya/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// rdo rje ye shes bla med ni// de ring nyid du dbab tu gsol/ gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las/ de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong gi lha tshogs thams cad kyang rgyud sde lnga'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya zhing rgyud sde lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags la ye shes phab/ de dag gis sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub zin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod// dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol/ gsum/ de nas bum dbang ni sdom pa rgya mtsho dang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar// skyob pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon gsum du// til gyi gang bu bzhin gang bas// rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni// bdag nyid (417)la ni dbang bskur bas// dkyil 'khor de nyid rig par gyur// zhes gsungs pas mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi phyag tu bum pa bzung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod// ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum chu mgo bor gtor zhing khar byin pas spyi bo gang*/ bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag /yul snang stong gi lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsang dbang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang sems khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de yang bde mchog bde ba myu gu'i rgyud las/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// mkha' mnyam ye shes bdud rtsi ni// rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas kyang*// bde ba bskyed phyir rigs kyi yum// sras bcas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes bum chu la mngar gsum sbyar ba'i gsang rdzas khar byin pas/ mgrin pa gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /sgra grags stong gi lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sher dbang la khyed rang rnams lha sku yab yum snyom par zhugs pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par mos shing*// bde mchog bde ba myu gu'i rgyud las/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/

zhes sngags kyi bum chus dbang bskur bas snying kha yan chag gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag /rang rig bde stong brjod bral (418)gyi lta ba rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bzhi pa la ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// oṃ badz+ra tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes sngags kyi bum chus dbang bskur bas// lus thams cad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag /'dzin rtog thams cad dang bral ba'i brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i lha brgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag gis rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi phul grub zin/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ chos chog rnams sngar sgyu lus dbang mo che'i skabs bzhin bya'o// blo chen kun gyis rtogs dka'i lam// zab don gsal ba'i gtso bsdus dbang*// bstan don snying por bris pa 'di// chos tshul skyong la mkho phyir bkod// zab lam ne gu chos drug dang 'brel ba'i slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa bde chen myu gu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis kyi rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs la// dngos po kun gyis phyag byas te// byin rlabs gzhung shing bka' drug las// gtum mo'i sgos bka' bshad par bya// 'dir gtum mo'i bka' byed pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob mas bya ba'i chos so// dang po 'di'i bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed dang*/

mdun bskyed kyi rtsa ba bcad gzhi bab tshul sngar bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur tshul skabs su brjod pa nyid yin pas de bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba la bgegs gtor btang ba spar bzhin la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la (419)thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo gsan snyam du/ kun slong dang*/ kun spyod rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas gsan par zhu/ de la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ne gu mas rdo rje 'chang la dngos su gsan pa'i zab chos ne gu chos drug tu grags pa'i khrid kyi skabs su med du mi rung ba'i bka' drug yod pa las/ da lam gtum mo'i sgos bka' byed pa yin/ de la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis yod pa'i dang po 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sprad la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug go / de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ nas/ mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ lan gsum/ de nas thun mong gi rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ gsum/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le bya zhing*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re gsal btab nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/
