oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mī/ slob dpon gyis snying khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas bzhag nas byin rlabs brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsad+dha badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas dam la bzhag pa'i slad du rdo rje mgo bor bzhag nas tshig 'di (420)la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyed kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// sangs rgyas sku ru khyed 'grub cing*// mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur// snying khar rdo rje gtugs te ye shes dbab pa gsang bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ bdud rtsi lnga yis chu blud nas dam tshig bsrung bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mri ta ud ka hūm̐/ yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig gi gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab bo// deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis// gal te nga la brnyas na ni// sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re// zhes brjod/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis// byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol// gsum/ de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba dang*/

phyogs bzhir snying po'i rnam 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pa la mos gus dung pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la phog pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis (421)'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang gi rnam par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs/ thams cad kyang byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang bcas bde mchog yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā/ zhes ye shes phab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal mdzad pa zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzad/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// sogs lan gsum bya/ de nas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams bde mchog yab rkyang du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan pa yar sna tshangs bug du zug cing*/ mas sna lte 'og du zug pa'i mas snar yi ge ram dmar po me'i rang bzhin can/ che chung ril ma tsam cig gsal legs par thob mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar slob dpon dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i mdun bskyed 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa zhig bsgom dgos pas 'di ltar gsal 'debs par zhu/ de yang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin can dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du slar yang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha nas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nas/ phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o//

zhes pa'i bar bde mchog lha lnga bzhin gsal gdab/ de ltar spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga la mchod yon/ (422)zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ bzhugs khri/ na bza' la sogs phyi'i mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa byed rang rnams kyis blos sprul te phul bas mnyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ yang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas yi ge 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te phul bas nang gi mchod pas mnyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ yang khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha nas rig ma brgyad dam bcu drug sprul te phul bas rjes chags kyi bde bas thugs rgyud gang ste mchod pas mnyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi/ de thams cad sgyu ma lta bu snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su shes pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul zhing mos gus drag po dung pa byas pas/ lte 'og gi ram las gtum mo ye shes kyi me ches phra ba zhig sbar te/ dbu ma'i nang nas yar song*/ tshangs bug nas thon/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i sku la phog pas/ bde drod kyi mchod pas mnyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu ste/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbu gtsug nas thim/ bde mchog yab yum gyi sku gang*/ de'i sku lus kyi cha thams cad las kyang byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can// dkar zhing dwangs ma'i rgyun byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs/

lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /lus (423)dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ bum dbang thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang spyi bo'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la mos gus dung ba byas pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dpag tu med pa'i rgyun byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ mgrin pa'i lam brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /rlung ngag dbyer med rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ gsang dbang thob byung snyams pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang spyi bo'i bde mchog yab yum la mos gus dung ba byas bas/ yum rdo rje phag mo las rang 'dra ba gnyis pa zhig chad/ des khyed rang rnams 'khor lo sdom pa yab rkyang du gsal ba'i sku la 'khyud cing*/ rjes su chags pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i yid kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /yid bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang spyi bo'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab 'od du zhu ste khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug tu thim/ khyed rang rnams 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i yum yang yab la thim/ rang nyid yab rkyang du gsal ba de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur te/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /de kho na nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/
(424)dbang bzhi pa thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag gis gtum mo'i sgos bka' grub/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ngo snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos

sogs dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngar bzhin bya/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon rnams byed pa rigs 'gre'o// blo ngan tshang tshing sreg pa'i thabs// rab gsal gtum mo'i me dbang yang*// ni gus bstan pa ji bzhin du// chos tshul skyong la mkho phyir bris// gtum mo'i dbang bskur brjod zin to// ༈ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa la// lus ngag yid gsum gus btud nas// byin rlabs gzhung shing bka' drug las/ sgyu lus sgos bka' bshad par bya// 'dir sgyu lus kyi bka' byed pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ slob ma la bya tshul lo// dang po la bca' gzhi dang*/ bdag mdun bsgrub tshul gtum mo'i skabs bzhin nyams su blangs pas don 'grub pa'o// gnyis pa la khrus phyag sngon 'gros slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ bgegs gtor btang*/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i thugs bsam khyad par can dung pa dang bcas ma yengs pas gsan par zhu// gsan bya dam pa'i chos zab lam ni gu chos drug gi sgyu lus kyi sgos bka' 'bul ba skabs su babs pa yin/ de la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po sngon 'gro'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsol ba 'debs pa/ 1 sdom pa 'dzin pa/ 2 zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed pa/ 3 dam bzhag bya ba/ 4 ye shes dbab pa ste/ badz+ra ā be sha a āḥ zhes pa'i bar gyi sngon 'gro lnga gtum mo'i skabs bzhin bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs gsum/ khyed rang rnams 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po nas ye shes (425)kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de lta bu'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba de nyid snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i spyi bor rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba// drwa ba gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ge'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du// slar yang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha nas me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gtum mo'i skabs bzhin/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo// lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas shing zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de dag gi steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa de rnams la khyed rang rnams kyis phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa rnams yid kyis sprul te phul ba'i mos pa dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes mos gus dung dung ba dang bcas pa'i yid kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab pa'i rkyen gyis 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs (426)rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/

bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku la zhugs pas de'i byin rlabs dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur te bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas snang ba 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba'o snyam pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /gnyis pa yang spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog la/ khyed rang rnams kyis phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas= bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes mos gus dung dung pa dang bcas= de rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo= khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs= ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas= sbyongs shig= gsum pa yang*/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog la= bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes mos gus dung dung pa dang bcas= de rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo/ khyed rang rnams kyis snying ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i yid kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas snang ba 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba'o snyam pa'i (427)sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /bzhi pa'i yang spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog la khyed rang rnams yid kyis phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa rnams sprul te phul ba'i mos pa dang bcas pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes mos gus dung dung ba dang bcas pa'i yid kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab pa'i rkyen gyis spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa 'phros/ mkha' dbyangs gang ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs brgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku gsung thugs la zhugs pas de'i byin rlabs dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur te bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas snang ba 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba'o snyam pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de nas mtha' bskor na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 'od du zhu nas spyi bo'i he ru ka lha lnga la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim par bsam la spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de dag gis sgyu lus (248)kyi sgos bka' grub/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam sdom bsrung ngo snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs man chad sngar bstan pa bzhin bya'o// ma dag blo yi 'char sngo ru// snang ba sna tshogs gsal mod kyi// sgyu mar bstan la yid ches nas// dran 'dun skyong phyir 'di don longs// sgyu lus kyi sgos bka' brjod zin to//

༈ dngos kun gcig tu sdom mdzad pa'i// he ru ka dpal la btud nas// byin rlabs gzhung shing bka' drug las// rmi lam sgos bka' bshad par bya// 'dir rmi lam gyi bka' bya ba la gnyis te slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya tshul lo// dang po bdag bskyed bsgom pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i go rim mchod brgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi ting nge 'dzin kyi dbang bskur skabs su bshad pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// ༈ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ khrus phyag nas brtsams te/ gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes ye shes dbab pa'i gsol ba 'debs yan/ sgyu lus kyi skabs dang 'dra/ de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa rgyud sde lnga yi lha tshogs su gsal ba dang bcas pa la/ mos gus dung pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis// slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la phog pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis 'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang gi rnam par gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rgyud sde lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ thams cad kyang byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang bcas rgyud sde lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes ye shes phab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ sogs gsum/ de nas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin (428)mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs su gsal 'debs dgos pas/ de yang rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes// shar gyi 'dab ma la gsang ba 'dus pa lhan skyes// lho'i 'dab ma la sgyu ma chen mo lhan skyes/ nub kyi 'dab ma la dges mdzad lhan skyes/ byang gi 'dab ma la 'jigs byed lhan skyes rnams bzhugs par gsal btab nas/ de rnams la khyed rang rnams kyis yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus dung dung pa sgoms mdzod/ de ltar byas pas mdun gyi bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor yer gyis byon// khyed rang rnams 'khor lo sdom pa yab rkyang du gsal ba'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa skad cig tsam gyis gsal pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang spyi bo'i rgyud sde lnga la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par ldem ldem zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab/ spyi bo'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i lte bar bla ma'i sku'i ngo bo bde mchog lhan skyes dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma ste snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi bzhugs par sgoms mdzod/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ bla ma'i gsung gi ngo bo ma hā mā yā lhan skyes dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro (430)rnams bzhugs par sgoms mdzod/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar bla ma'i thugs kyi ngo bo dges mdzad rdo rje lhan skyes// phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad la shar du gau rī/

lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai tā lī/ byang du gha sma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī// shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du ḍom bi nī rnams sgoms mdzod/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar bla ma'i yon tan gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis 'dus su gyur pa'i ngo bo gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam dpal rdo rje rtsa zhal dang sku lus gur gum gyi mdog ltar dmar ser/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis pu sti dang gzhu 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la shar du sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo// lhor ma mā ki sngon mo// nub tu gos dkar mo dmar mo/ byang du sgrol ma ljang khu rnams bzhugs par sgoms mdzod/ de nas dbang bskur ba la/ mtshon byed dpe'i sgo nas dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la bzhi las dang po bum dbang gi don du khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i nang gi bde mchog lha lnga la mos gus drag po dung pa byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sku la thim/ de rnams kyi sku las kyang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab rnams brgyud de/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis lam ste gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ (431)lus kyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa bzla zhing spos rol bya/

'og tu yang lha rang rang gi sngags bzla zhing byin 'bebs kyi rol mo byed pa rigs 'gre'o// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gi don du khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi ma hā mā yā lha lnga la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ma hā mā yā lha lnga'i sku la thim// de rnams las kyang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab rnams brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis lam ste gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol sngags bzla ba 'gre'o// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi dges mdzad rdo rje lha dgu la mos gus drag pos dung pa byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dges mdzad rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha'i dges mdzad rdo rje lha dgu la thim/ de rnams las kyang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha'i rtsa 'dab rnams brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis lam ste gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol bya ba gong bzhin/ bzhi pa tshig dbang gi don du khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i nang gi gsang ba 'dus pa lha lnga la mos gus drag po dung pa byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam dpal rdo rje lha lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i 'jam dpal rdo rje lha lnga la thim/ de rnams (432)las kyang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/

khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i rtsa 'dab rnams brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis lam ste gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ḍhṛ kra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes bzla zhing spos rol bya'o// gnyis pa mtshon bya don gyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du mos pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga la mos gus dung pa byas pas de 'od du ldem gyis zhu mgrin pa'i ma hā mā yā la thim pas dga' ba'i ye shes skyes te bum pa'i dbang thob/ yang mgrin pa'i sgyu ma chen mo lha lnga la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de 'od du ldem gyis zhu ste snying ga'i dges mdzad rdo rje lha dgu la thim pas mchog dga'i ye shes skyes te gsang dbang thob// yang snying ga'i dgos mdzad rdo rje lha dgu la mos gus dung pa byas pas de 'od du ldem gyis zhu ste lte ba'i 'jam dpal rdo rje lha lnga la thim pas khyad dga'i ye shes skyes te sher dbang thob/ yang lte ba'i 'jam dpal rdo rje lha lnga la mos gus dung pa byas pas de 'od du ldem gyis zhu ste stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thim pas lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes te dbang bzhi pa thob/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'od kyi ga'u kha sbyor nang du rgyud sde lnga'i snying po yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i 'bru lnga 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba de la sems gtad nas/ snang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa cung zad sbyong ba zhu/ de rnams kyis rmi lam gyi sgos bka' phul grub zin/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig bsrung ngo snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa sogs man chad dang*/ rjes chog byed pa dkyus ltar ro// a 'thas blo (433) yis bcings pa las// nyid 'khrul rmi lam gsal bas na// gdams ngag 'di ru bstan pa bzhin/ nyams myong skyong rnams ya mtshan che// rmi lam gyi sgos bka' brjod zin to//

༈ sgyu ma chen mo zhes bya ba'i// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug la btud nas// byin rlabs gzhung shing bka' drug las// 'od gsal sgos bka' bshad par bya/ 'dir 'od gsal gyi sgos bya ba la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma rjes su bzung tshul lo// dang po maṇ+ḍal 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tshom bu sngon po// shar du sngon po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang gu rnams bkod/ mchod gtor sogs gong dang 'dra ba bsham/ bdag bskyed lha lnga'i skabs bzhin dang*/ mdun bskyed/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'byung bzhi ri rab sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po yid tsam khro ba/ rdo rje dang dril 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pas rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shang*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// 'dab ma bzhi la shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo// byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu rnams gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa ma dzaḥn mo bud+dha 'i mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral ba oṃ nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa'i ngang rgyud sde lnga'i skabs bzhin las/ rigs lnga so sos dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod bstod lha lnga'i skabs bzhin bya ba'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ khrus phyag nas brtsams te/ gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar rmi lam gyi skabs dang 'dra'o// de nas slob dpon he ru ka rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can du gsal ba'i mtha' skor du rgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i (434)tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la mos gus dung ba byas pa'i rkyen gyis/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros// khyed rang rnams la phog pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis 'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang gi rnam par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ de rnams kyang bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rnams par zhu ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ na mo bud+dha ya 'i sngags dang yi ge bdun pa'i mthar/ badz+ra ā we sha ya a āḥ/ zhes spos rol dang bcas ye shes phab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// byang chub rdo rjes sogs/ spyan dmigs 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnam la 'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang du gsal ba'i spyi bor rdo rjes gzhi// rwa ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du slar yang sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ de rnams kyi steng gi (435)nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/

myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ de rnams la mos gus dung ba byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i bla ma he ru ka lha lnga'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ rin po che'i rigs kyi bye brag dpag tu med pa sprul te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad phyur bur gang bas spyi bo'i bla ma he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ de'i yang steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la phul bas mchod pas mnyes par bsam zhing bdag la yang dag par 'od gsal gyi dbang bskur du gsol/ khyad par du yang bum pa'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes yid kyis gsol ba dung dung btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la phog pas thugs brgyud rang dbang med par bskul te/ de rnams kyi dpral ba nas sku'i byin rlabs kyi ngo bo 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las kyang 'od zer dkar po'i byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar zhugs te/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus kyi sdig (436)sgrib thams cad dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i dngos grub bstsal byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis nas khyad par du yang gsang ba'i dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/

zhes dang*/ de rnams kyi mgrin pa nas gsung gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de las kyang 'od zer dmar po'i byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs te/ mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang bas ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi dngos grub stsal byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de bzhin du rigs 'gre shes par byas te/ khyad par du yang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang skur bstsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pa zhes pa dang*/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de las kyang 'od zer sngon po zhes pa dang*/ snying ga nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i nang thams cad gang bas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi dngos grub thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ yang phyi nang gsang ba nas dbang bzhi bstsal du gsol/ zhes yid kyis gsol ba dung dung btab pas spyi bo'i= /thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul te steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu ste spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ 'khor rnams kyang rim pa bzhin du bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum la thim/ de nyid kyang byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste slob ma'i lus la thim pas rang lus dang snang ba thams cad 'od gsal du yal nas sems ma bcos pa la cung zad mnyam (437)par zhog mdzod/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de dag gis 'od gsal gyi sgos bka' grub zin pa yin/

dbang dus su thob pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa phan chad dang*/ rjes kyi cho ga dkyus ltar ro// rgya 'byams blo yi 'khrul rtog kun// 'od gsal klong du thim ched du// 'di ru bstan pa'i gdams ngag la// yid ches skyongs shig shes ldan rnams// 'od gsal gyi sgos bka' btad zin to// ༈ dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo la btud de// ye shes chos sku'i zhing khams su// 'pho thabs sgos bka' bshad par bya// 'dir 'pho ba'i bka' bya ba la slob dpon gyi las dang slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu lnga dmar po bkod/ mchod gtor sogs sngar dang 'dra ba bsham/ bdag bskyed bde mchog lha lnga'am/ rnal 'byor la sgom yang shin tu rung*/ mdun bskyed sum+bha ni sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar mi ro dkar po mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing kha/ byang gi 'dab ma la lā ma ljang gu/ nub kyi 'dab ma la dum skyes ma dmar mo// lho'i 'dab mi la gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang gcer mo skra grol ba phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thur du sdig pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs gnyis bsgrad pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor phaiṃ/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ (438)shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ lā ma la don grub/ dum skyes la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ phyi mchod nang mchod rnams bde mchog lha lnga'i skabs bzhin dang dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod pa dang*/ oṃ gsum ma ci 'grub bzla ba/ gtor ma 'bul ba sogs 'don bsgyur phran bu ma gtog lha lnga'i skabs bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu sogs bya/ slob dpon gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs sngon 'gro'i chos bshad bsdus pa nas bzung*/ ye shes dbab pa'i gsol 'debs/ gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes pa yan chad gtum mo'i skabs bzhin du shes par bya ba sngar bzhin no// de nas ye shes 'bebs pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la khyed rang rnams kyis mos gus dung ba byas pas/ mdun bskyed rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs pas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad (439)nas mnyam par zhog mdzod/

oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha a āḥ zhes gang mang brjod cing spos rol bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// byang chub rdo rjes sogs gsum/ de nas spyan dmigs 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkha' la srung 'khor gyi nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba'i 'od kyi rang bzhin can de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar mi ro dkar po mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thur du brkyang ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs gnyis bsgrad pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams kyi rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ chos 'byung gi zur drug la/ oṃ bam/ ham yom/ hriṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams go cha'i dpa' mo drug gi ngo bor yod pa dang g.yung drung 'khyil ba drug dang bcas pa gsal bar sgoms mdzod/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos sprul te phul la/ bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dbyer ma mchis pa'i sku la thim pas (340)thugs kar byang chub sems su zhu ba'i dwangs ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa gsang gnas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor nas thon/
khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/

spos rol bya ba bgre'o// yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol= khyed rang rnams kyi lce steng nas zhugs/ mgrin pa brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ yang phyi nang gsang ba= shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol= khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas zhugs/ de las brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ yang phyi nang = bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du ldem ste zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ sems mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du cung zad snyoms par zhog mdzod/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ 'pho ba'i sgos bka' dngos gzhi de yan chad kyis grub pa yin/ da zhar la man ngag bzhin 'pho ba'i dmigs pa 'di bzhin lan gsum la sogs pa bya bar gsung pas de'i bsgom tshul ni 'di ltar yin te/ khyed rang rnams bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i kha mtshams kyi dbus su khyed rang rnams kyi rnam shes kyi ngo bo a dkar po shin tu dkar la 'tsher ba zhig gsal thob cig /(341)chos 'byung gi 'og zur gyi nang du rlung gi rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon zhig gsal thob cig /de gnyis gsal thebs nas/ da spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs par gsal thob cig /'o de nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi steng 'og g.yas g.yon thams cad nas rlung rnams rim pas bsdus te/

lte ba'i a la thim pas rlung sems thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i mos pa dang bcas rlung nang du cung zad bzung mdzod/ de nas chos 'byung gi 'og zur gyi hūm̐ las shugs dang ldan pa'i rlung dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ a yig de nyid yer gyis btegs te skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin tshangs bug nas rgyang gis thon/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar thim par bsam la hi ka drag po brjod cig yang phaṭa brjod pa dang mnyam du a yig lte bar phab/ sngar bzhin khyed rang rnams bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i nas/ hika drag po brjod cig / ces pa'i bar lan gsum bskyar/ mthar khyed rang rnams kyi lus sems med bem po ro dang 'dra ba de 'og tu bzhag /sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa de nyid sgra 'od dang bcas te mkha' dbyings mthon por je mtho je mthor gshegs te thag ring por song ba dang mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur par bsam la/ rig pa brjod med du mi rtog pa'i ngang la ci gnas mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de nas rang sems dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku de nyid dal bus byon te/ rang lus bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i spyi bor byon pas/ de las rang gi rlung sems kyi ngo bo a dkar po zhu ba'i dwangs ma byang sems dkar dmar gyi rnam pa drod dang rlan gsher gyi rang bzhin can chi li li byung tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lte ba'i chos 'byung du slebs pa na drod (442)tsha hur gyis thon/ rig pa gsal sing nge byung shes pa bde chi le ba 'bol le shig ge gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar gyur pa'i mod la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yang 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu nas spyi bo nas thim pas lus khengs pa'i tshangs bug gi shul gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis bkag par bsam mo// gtso bo sa ji ltar sogs dang maṇ+ḍal/ rjes chog rnams spyi ltar bya ba nyid do// blo 'das 'od gsal 'pho ba'i lam// mdzub tshugs bstan pas sdig can yang*// bsgom tshe grol ba the tshom med// nyams khrid skyong ba skal ldan lags/

'pho ba'i sgos bka' bshad zin to// ༈ e ma ho bdag med mkha' 'gro dang*// sems kyi mdud grol rje bla ma// tha dad med la gus btud nas// bar do'i dbang bskur bshad par bya// 'dir bar do'i sgos bka' bya ba la gnyis te slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma rjes 'dzin no// dang po maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad la tshom bu sngon po dgu bkod pa'i mthar mchod gtor bsham/ bde mchog lha lnga dang rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus ci yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bsgom/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa'i rtse mor 'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte bar bcom ldan 'das dges mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i gdan la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gi rgyan sogs mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas a brgyad spros pa las 'dab ma brgyad la rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa brgyad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar (443)oṃ nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang yum rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs lha lnga'i skabs bzhin las/ 'don 'gyur kha spos bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa la ye shes 'bebs pa'i gsol 'debs yan chad kyi sngon 'gro lnga pa dkyus bzhin te gtum mo'i skabs sogs su bshad pa ltar ro//

de nas khyed rang rnams bde mchog yab rkyang du gsal ba'i ngang nas bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i mdun bskyed dges mdzad rdo rje bdag med ma la sogs pa lha dgu'i tshogs la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dges mdzad rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba spyan drangs/ de rnams thams cad rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas mnyam par zhog mdzod/ oṃ de wa pi tsu'i mthar badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes gang mang brjod la ye shes dbab/ de nas dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ sogs lan gsum/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa gsal 'debs pa ni/ de yang srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa'i rtse mo 'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar bcom ldan dges mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhabs g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i gdan la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod (444)rlon gyi do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtha' skor du pad 'dab brgyad la rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa brgyad kyis bskor ba dngos su bzhugs 'dug snyam pa'i mos pa dang bcas de rnams la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa blos sprul te phul la/

bdag la bar do rgyal ba longs sku'i dbang bskur bstsal du gsol zhes yid kyis gsol ba dung ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkha' dbyings gang ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te dges mdzad rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku la thim/ yang mos gus dung ba byas pas khyed rang rnams tha mal par gsal ba'i spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la yer gyis byon nas bzhugs par sgoms mdzod/ de rnams la slar yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul zhing bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pa'i rkyen gyis spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i dges mdzad rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar la dwangs pa 'od 'tshor zhing nyams bde ba chen po dang ldan pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ rnam smin gyis sha khrag rus gsum sogs tha mal pa'i lus yongs su dag ste dges mdzad rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ lha sku snang stong sgyu (445)ma lta bu de la sems gtad nas cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ 'o de ni bum dbang gi don yin no// gnyis pa yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes yid kyis gsol ba btab pas rdo rje bdag med ma brgyad po rnams gcig tu 'dus te dges mdzad rdo rje'i sku la 'khyud cing yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rgyun babs te/

khyed rang rnams kyi lce rtse nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par mos te cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ 'o de ni gsang dbang gi don yin no// gsum pa yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i bdag med ma las sku gnyis pa zhig chad de/ khyed rang rnams dges mdzad rdo rjer gsal ba la 'khyud pas srub dang srub pa'i sbyor ba spangs te/ yab yum phan tshun 'khyud pa tsam gyis bde stong gi ye shes skyes par mos la sems cung zad gtong mdzod/ 'o de ni shes rab ye shes kyi don yin no// bzhi pa yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes yid kyis gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma'i sku dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dges mdzad rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa 'od du ldem gyis zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas sgo gsum sku bzhi'i ngo bor gyur par mos te sems ma bcos pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par (446)zhog mdzod/ 'o de ni dbang bzhi pa'i don yin no// de nas dbang don dmigs rim du 'dril dgos pas/ slar yang khyed rang rnams dges mdzad rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba de nyid nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur te/ stong pa nyid nam mkha'i dbyings lta bur sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba gcig byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la mngal gyi skye gnas yin/ rtogs pa rnams la ni 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang yin 'dug snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas chos 'byung gi nang du khyed rang rnams hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur par bsgoms mdzod/

hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros// 'das ma 'ong da lta dus gsum gyi skye gnas la zhen pa'i dug gsum gyi bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ hūm̐ de nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snang ba 'di thams cad bar do'i snang ba yin/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs sogs snang ba thams cad yi dam gyi sku dang*/ sgra grags pa thams cad yi dam gyi gsung dang*/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs kyi ngo bo yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ mthar thams cad kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs par gyur pa la cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des bar do'i sgos bka' grub pas/ de'i dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams srung ngo snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo sa ji ltar sogs gsum// bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar spyi dang mthun par bya'o// rtog ge'i blo yis dpyad dka' ba'i// zab gsal snying po gsang sngags kyi// bstan pa'i bcud gyur chos drug la// yid ches nyams khrid skyong ba rmad// bar do'i sgos bka' brjod zin to// (447) zab lam ni gu chos drug dang 'brel ba'i slob ma rjes su 'dzin thabs bde chen myu gu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ byin rlabs gzhung shing bka' drug gi rab tu byed pa ste gsum pa'o// de ltar bka' bcu'i byin rlabs skor rang gi thob rgyun ltar rje btsun tā ra nā tha rin po ches mdzad pa'i yi ge dang*/ rje btsun gyi gsung la bla chen ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris mdzad pa'i yi ge ma bu rnams la gzhi byas/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung dang*/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma'i yig sna mang ba 'dug pa rnams la'ang dbang po'i tshul du gtugs shing don dang mi 'gal ba rnams ma gtogs rje btsun gyi gsung nyid khyung po'i bzhed srol gtsang ma kho nar mthong nas de la yid ches su byas nas bkod pa'o// 'dir smras pa/

dpal ldan rdo rje btsun mo ni gu mas// khyung po'i mtshan can grub thob lo tsā bar// chig brgyud bka' rgyas gdams pa'i gser chos lam// 'di 'dra zab zab phal gyi dper mi mtshungs// bka' bcu'i phyag len gsal bar bkod pa 'dri// byin rlabs brgyud pa 'chal du gzhug phyir min// tshe 'di'i 'khri ba gcod pa'i skal ldan la// mkha' 'gro'i zhal blangs mas 'phro phyir yin// de skad dam nyams 'dre la mi bskur zhing*// yon ngor ster ba'i mu stegs gsang tshig srol// dor nas chos 'di'i brgyud pa spel nus na// kho bo zol med dad pa'i spu longs g.yo// 'di la gang nongs bdag gis nyes pa ste// legs bshad srid tshe de ni bla ma'i drin// nyes pa'i rtsa ba ma rig dang bcas pa// bla ma'i thugs rje'i me yis bsreg tu gsol// 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yis// ma rgan 'khor ba'i sems can ji snyed kun// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te// bde chen rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /ces zab lam ni gu chos drug gi bka' bcu'i phyag len bde chen myu gu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba dge slong 'dul 'dzin byang chub smon lam gyis don gnyer chen pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ grub pa'i dbang phyug a wa dhū ti ba chen po mthu stobs zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa shākya'i dge slong blo gsal bstan skyong gis/ zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya yi lo/ cho 'phrul zla'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i nyin gdan sa chen po zhwa lu ri phug gi sgrub khang rnam grol yang rtse sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang dpal ldan shangs pa

(448) bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ chos 'di yang gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don byed nus par gyur cig /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang phrin las mdzod cig /brgyud pa ni bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ma gtogs pa de byings tshang ma la rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu zhabs/ khyung po lo tsā ba tshul khrims mgon po// rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer sgang ba chos kyi seng ge /gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ chos rjes sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge /mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge /shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ lkugs lung pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom rin po che legs pa rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog /brag stod pa chos sku lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po/ mthu btsun rin po che kun dga' bsod nams/ rmog lcogs byams pa lhun grub/ rje byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ 'tsho byed ngag dbang blo gros/ 'khrul zhig ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs/ chos rje grags pa chos 'phel/ a wa dhū ti pa chen po mthu stobs zhabs/ des bdag blo gsal bstan skyong la'o/ bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol mgon yan chad sngar bzhin la/ de nas rang grol ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal dbang lhun grub/ spro mo lung pa bsod nams chos 'phel/ gnas gsar pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang*/ grub dbang chos nyid ye shes/ byams pa bsod nams dbang phyug /dge slong a wa dhū ti pa chen po grub dbang don yod rdo rje/

des bdag la'o// spyir rje btsun grol mchog la ni gu chos drug gi brgyud tshul la mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam yod par grags shing*/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po las byung ba'i nye brgyud dang*/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po las byung ba'i nye brgyud sogs kyang tshang bar bzhugs pas kun dga' grol mchog (449) las brgyud pa'i shangs chos skor brgyud pa phyogs re las 'ongs pa ma yin par kun 'dus su shes par byas nas kho bos 'bad pas btsal ba yin no// yang brgyud lugs gcig ni/ shangs ston chen po gtsang ma man chad sngar bzhin la de nas/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jags chen byams pa dpal/ chos rje blo gros dpal/ mkhas btsun kun dga' dpal/ rje bsod nams bzang po/ grub dbang chos kyi nyi ma/ mkhas dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog kun dga' chos grags/ mtshungs med nam mkha' chos dar/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rje kun dga' don grub/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams/ mkhan chen rgyal dbang lhun grub man sngar bzhin yin no// ༈ paṇa chen ngag chos kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas su kha sid+dhi'i byin rlabs lung bcas dang*/ ni gu chos drug gi nyams len snying por dril ba'i khrid lung gi brgyud pa'ang de bzhin yin te rje bla ma dge slong a wa dhū ti chen pos bdag la gnang ba'o// 'dis 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skem par gyur cig// /
